answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 122 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the marble challenge, the orchard audit can replay the glacier history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3632 identities would post 2760 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
